title: Tree circuit complexity class
statement: For a natural number $d$, a Boolean language belongs to the tree circuit class with polynomial size and depth bounded by a degree-$d$ polynomial in $ loor{\log_2 n}+1$ if there is a family of Boolean tree circuits that recognizes the language, has fan-in at most two at every input length, has polynomial size, and has depth at most a degree-$d$ polynomial in $ loor{\log_2 n}+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean tree circuit family exists
The family has fan-in at most two at every input length
The family has depth bounded by a degree-d polynomial in floor(log₂ n)+1
The language recognized by the family equals L
